description:
MailboxName::is_internationalized (pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:233-236, 280) is set from `!local_raw.is_ascii()` only. The field name evokes RFC 6532's 'internationalized email address', which per RFC 6532 §3.2 is an address with non-ASCII in EITHER local-part OR domain.

The current usage is correct for its purpose — it gates whether the rfc822Name branch is eligible, and rfc822Name (IA5String) cannot carry non-ASCII LOCAL-PARTs. Domain non-ASCII is harmless because domain_a_label is always normalized to ASCII.

Suggested rewrite: rename to `local_is_non_ascii` (what it actually means) so a future contributor doesn't add a 'is_internationalized = !local_raw.is_ascii() || domain_was_u_label' line that breaks the rfc822Name dispatch. Either rename the field or add a one-line comment explaining the gate semantics (local-only by design).
title: is_internationalized name suggests RFC 6532 'internationalized email address' but only checks local-part
